name: Laws of Attraction
source:
A surprise job offer takes you from your small town law firm to New York’s most prestigious firm. Can you handle the highest levels of law… and love?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Laws_of_Attraction,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
